nutshell.headline: 412 new failures across AudienceGroup, Fieldwork and Lookup — the new typed error-code assertions can't read valid API error responses.
nutshell.causeText: NXS-13667 "typed error-code assertions across regression suite" (45817a8833bb, gergely.gimesi) added a new NexusApiErrors helper and rewired the *ValidationsTestSteps across AudienceGroup, Fieldwork and Lookup; the APIs still return correct 400/404/500 error bodies, but the helper returns null so ~75 assertions (NexusApiErrors.dkmsError/status(...), err?.status) now fail. Prior build #3.0.2663 was green (0 fails) and only this test-module change touches the failing areas, so this is a test-code regression — not a product or infra break. The single BOS 502 Bad Gateway is unrelated QA infra noise.
nutshell.investigation: ~75 of the classified new fails are Spock assertions on the new NexusApiErrors helper (dkmsError/status(...) returning null) although the APIs returned valid 400/404/500 bodies. Introduced by NXS-13667 (gergely.gimesi, 45817a8833bb), whose changed step files cover exactly AudienceGroup, Fieldwork and Lookup; last night was green.
bullets: 60× "Condition not satisfied" — NexusApiErrors.dkmsError/status(exception) returns null though the API returned a valid 400/404 (e.g. "Unsupported country! [countryIso:ZZ]", "No enum constant …DeliveryMode.INVALID")
15× NOT_FOUND assertions — same helper returns null on 500 EmptyResultDataAccessException for non-existent IDs
Test-code change NXS-13667 (gergely.gimesi, 45817a8833bb) touches AudienceGroup, Fieldwork, Lookup — 79 overlapping new fails; 1 BOS 502 is infra noise

detail.investigation: 412 of 413 unmuted failures are new since prior build #3.0.2663, which was fully green (0 fails). The failures are not product errors: in the 60× assert_fail cluster the API returns the correct response (400 "Unsupported country! [countryIso:ZZ]", 400 "No enum constant …DeliveryMode.INVALID", 404 "Project not found") but the newly added NexusApiErrors helper fails to parse it — assertions like `NexusApiErrors.dkmsError(exception) != null`, `NexusApiErrors.status(exception) == "BAD_REQUEST"` and `err?.status == "BAD_REQUEST"` all evaluate against null. The 15× product_data_not_found cluster is the same helper returning null on 500 EmptyResultDataAccessException for bogus IDs. The one and only change that touches the failing step files is NXS-13667 (45817a8833bb, gergely.gimesi), "typed error-code assertions across regression suite", which added NexusApiErrors.java and rewrote AudienceGroupValidationsTestSteps / AudienceTemplateTestSteps / AudienceTemplateValidationsTestSteps (AudienceGroup), FieldworkValidationTestSteps (Fieldwork) and QuotaGroupLookupValidationTestSteps (Lookup) — exactly the hot areas (AudienceGroup 44, Fieldwork 30, Lookup 5). This is a test-code/assertion regression in the TA module, not a product regression: the QA-deployed backend services return valid error bodies, so they are not implicated by these assertion-parsing failures. Genuine infra/product noise is limited to 1× BOS 502 Bad Gateway (QA gateway) and 1× server NPE, one occurrence each.
bullets: 412 of 413 unmuted fails are new vs prior build #3.0.2663 (0 fails) — a clean-to-broken jump in one night

60× "Condition not satisfied": NexusApiErrors.dkmsError/status(exception) and err?.status return null, yet the API returned the expected 400/404 error body (e.g. "Unsupported country! [countryIso:ZZ]", "No enum constant …DeliveryMode.INVALID")
15× NOT_FOUND: NexusApiErrors.status(exception) == "NOT_FOUND" fails on 500 EmptyResultDataAccessException for non-existent IDs — same broken helper
Root cause: test-code change NXS-13667 (45817a8833bb, gergely.gimesi) — new NexusApiErrors.java + rewired step files map exactly to AudienceGroup/Fieldwork/Lookup (79 overlapping new fails)
APIs behaved correctly — QA-deployed backend services (ClientRestJ21, ProjectApiGateway, etc.) are not implicated by these assertion-parsing failures
3× PES soft-launch vs tally — shared-fixture test/data noise, unrelated to the helper
1× BOS 502 Bad Gateway — transient QA infra; 1× server NPE — isolated product path, one occurrence each
